subject: RE: Demo tomorrow — SSO blocks Meet link, need alt provisioning
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@intelliflow.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@intelliflow.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Demo tomorrow — can't join Meet (SSO)

Hi Marissa,

We are scheduled for the product demo tomorrow at 11:00am PT but both Priya and I are getting blocked by our org's SSO when we click the Google Meet link in the invite. The browser shows a SAML redirect error (we captured a short trace).

Symptoms:
- Clicking the Meet link gives a 403 with a SAML redirect loop.
- Priya (guest) sees a banner: "You can't join with your account".
- Our calendar shows the original invite but when we open details the meeting URL is empty for some attendees.

We need either: an alternative join URL (Zoom or dial-in), or for you to reissue the invite from a different organizer account that doesn't enforce our org's SSO policy. We're trying to avoid rescheduling — the demo team and legal are both short on availability.

Attached: saml_trace.txt (short stack).

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Director of Integrations
Intelliflow Inc.
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir@intelliflow.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@intelliflow.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:28:17 -07:00
Subject: RE: Demo tomorrow — can't join Meet (SSO)

Thanks for the details, Samir — sorry you're hitting this so close to the demo. I reviewed the trace and it looks like Intelliflow's IdP is rejecting redirects from cross-domain organizers when the invite is received via calendar forwarding. Two quick options to avoid rescheduling:

1) Alternate Zoom meeting (fastest) — I can create a Zoom meeting from our Redwood demo account and send an ICS that should bypass your SSO enforcement for guests. I'll attach invite_alt_zoom.ics and reissue the invite from that account.

2) Re-provision organizer rights for tomorrow only — if you prefer Google Meet, Ben (cc'd) can claim host briefly and republish the invite from a non-enterprise organizer so your IdP won't block it. This requires a 2-minute change on your side to accept the reissued invite.

Please confirm: are non-Intelliflow attendees joining (vendor partners)? Also let me know whether you want Zoom (option 1) or organizer reprovision (option 2). If Zoom, I'll send the alt invite now and include dial-in.

Also attaching a short mutual action plan so we have rollback items if the alt link fails.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119
From: ben_carter@redwood.com

On Tue, Oct 27, 2026 at 9:28 AM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Please confirm: are non-Intelliflow attendees joining (vendor partners)? Also let me know whether you want Zoom (option 1) or organizer reprovision (option 2).

Samir — quick SE note: if you want to try organizer reprovision, here's the fastest safe path (no changes to your IdP):

1) I will create a new Redwood calendar event from demo@redwood.com and mark your original event as "optional" (so RSVPs don't duplicate).
2) I'll set a temporary moderator role and include a short passcode in the Meet link metadata (Google Meet admin-side).
3) If any attendee still sees the SSO redirect, we fall back to the Zoom ICS I'm attaching.

If you pick Zoom, I will: create a Zoom meeting, attach invite_alt_zoom.ics, set co-host as demo@redwood.com, and email a one-line dial-in. That usually resolves SSO-block issues because Zoom links are not subject to your IdP's calendar-level redirect rules.

I'll stand by at 10:30 PT to help claim host if you want reprovision.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Samir Rao <samir@intelliflow.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@intelliflow.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:55:20 -07:00
Subject: RE: Demo tomorrow — can't join Meet (SSO)

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick options. Let's go with the Zoom fallback (option 1) to avoid any calendar churn on our side. Please send the alt invite and a dial-in; I'll confirm with Priya.

Also, after the demo we'd like a short note describing what caused the SSO rejection so our IdP team can whitelist any necessary redirect origins for future sessions. The saml_trace should help — shout if you need more logs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the demo.

— Samir
